title: Advanced HTML Viewer
description: Marks and notes on HTML files, stored in the file itself.

author.title: Note handle
author.description: The handle written on every note line you add, without the leading @. Empty writes @user, and you are asked for a handle the first time you write a note. Set note handle in the command palette puts the same question again.

tabCue.title: Tab marker
tabCue.description: Show a marker on the tab of a file that changes on disk: a half circle whose filled half swaps sides while changes arrive, and a green dot for changes that arrived while the tab was behind another. Off shows no marker.
